description: This file defines an abstract class 'ImageWorker' that handles loading images asynchronously into ImageView components in Android. It manages caching (memory and disk), background processing of images, fade-in effects, and work management (starting, canceling, pausing). It serves as a utility component for efficient and smooth image display in an Android app.

classes.name: ImageWorker
classes.description: Abstract class providing asynchronous image loading with caching, placeholder management, and fade-in effects for Android ImageViews.

classes.name: AsyncDrawable
classes.description: A custom Drawable holding a WeakReference to the background task, used as a placeholder during image loading.

classes.name: BitmapWorkerTask
classes.description: AsyncTask subclass performing background bitmap processing and updating ImageView upon completion.

classes.name: OnImageLoadedListener
classes.description: Callback interface for notifying when an image has finished loading.

methods.name: loadImage
methods.description: Starts asynchronous loading of an image into an ImageView, using cache if available.

methods.name: setLoadingImage
methods.description: Sets a placeholder image shown while the actual image is loading.

methods.name: addImageCache
methods.description: Associates an ImageCache with this ImageWorker for caching images.

methods.name: setImageFadeIn
methods.description: Enables or disables fade-in animation when images are loaded.

methods.name: setExitTasksEarly
methods.description: Signals background tasks to cancel or exit early, useful during UI scolling.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears both memory and disk caches.
